claims: Tom Izzo is the head men's basketball coach at Michigan State University.
Tom Izzo has held the position of head men's basketball coach at Michigan State University since March 1995.
As of March 2026, Tom Izzo is a Hall of Fame coach.
Tom Izzo was inducted into the Hall of Fame in 2016.
Tom Izzo has led the Spartans to eight Final Fours.
Tom Izzo has led the Spartans to 11 Big Ten regular-season championships.
Tom Izzo led the Spartans to a national title in 2000.
Tom Izzo is a 2000 NCAA National Champion.
Tom Izzo has 8 Final Four appearances.
Tom Izzo is 4x Big Ten Coach of the Year.
Tom Izzo led MSU to the 2026 NCAA Tournament round of 32.
Robyn Fralick is the women's head coach at Michigan State.
The Michigan State men's basketball staff includes assistant coach Saddi Washington.
The Michigan State University Athletics website lists all staff for the men's basketball team.
